body: Round 1 (7c8e7484..37bf6a51), P2 high, class jq-program-location, row 4302629300: the word walker's "[^"]*" ignored \" and [^\s'"] split a\ b, so the argument count landed on the wrong word and the program was never read (jq -n --arg p "a\"b" 'select(.url == $p)' exited 0; the base reported R3). Fixed in 1b56dc2b by the re-plan: the base scan with JQ_QUOTE ("..." consumed whole, escape-aware) and JQ_ARG skip rules; guard tests in be2958cf, red at 37bf6a51 (validation 3b).

Round 1, P2 high, class jq-program-location: the walker took the first word not starting with - for the program and read nothing when that word had no single-quoted run, so "${opts[@]}", "$@", $flags, 2>/dev/null, <<<"$x", nested quotes in $( ), $(git rev-parse ...) and a -r\ continuation hid programs the base read. Fixed in 1b56dc2b: the locator is the base scan (first single-quoted string on the logical line) with candidates skipped only when they are an option's argument or inside "...", so it cannot read less than the base; the edge-shape table (validation 10a) shows the head reporting every shape the base or 37bf6a51 reports.

Round 1, P2 medium, row 4302629307: the per-value check refused map(re.escape, names) and {3} where the base accepted, and still accepted {re.escape(a) + b} within one value. map(re.escape, ...) fixed in 1b56dc2b (a value counts when any node is the re.escape reference; test in be2958cf, red at 37bf6a51). {3} and {re.escape(a) + b} are declared residuals in report.md (the 200-line cap; none in the tree).

Round 1, P3 medium, row 4302629305: the word check is still met by a jq comment, the object shorthand {canonical_path}, an object key and a def inside a side. The comment fixed in 1b56dc2b (comments stripped with the strings; test in be2958cf, red at 37bf6a51); the other three are declared residuals in report.md (excluding a word before : or after { puts the line over 120 columns and the script over 200 lines; none in the tree).

Round 1, P3 high: the docstring's last line lost 'repo-relative' outside the owned rows. Declared: it is the cap's text trim the TASK note allows ('trim text if needed'); no behaviour, argparse description or --list-rules output changes (validation 8).

Round 2 (37bf6a51..1b56dc2b), P3 high, row 4302629300: report.md's claim that the skips cannot read less than the base was false: with jq inside a double-quoted expansion and more text before its closing quote ("$(command -v jq 2>/dev/null)", "${tools[jq]}", "$bin/jq.exe", "$(type -p jq | head -n1)"), JQ_QUOTE stopped at the unbalanced quote the base read through. Fixed in bb60ee84 (a bare quote as the last alternative under a possessive repetition; tests in a0563644, red at 1b56dc2b); report.md's wording corrected.

Round 2, P3 medium, row 4302629300: a single-quoted value joined to other text in one word is still read as the program ('it'\''s', "$x"'/y', $'/x', -L'/lib', -nL '/lib'). The base misses each too, so no regression; declared as a residual in report.md (a second option pattern line would exceed the 200-line cap).

Round 2, P3 medium, row 4302629305: object keys, the {canonical_path} shorthand and a def inside a side still satisfy the word check; already declared as residuals in report.md. The reviewer confirmed the comment strip adds no false hit (split("#") and "a\"#" sides stay accepted).

Round 2, P3 medium, row 4302629307: {re.escape(prefix) + name} and constants stay as declared; a value that only mentions re.escape without calling it ({name if re.escape else ''}) passes the reference check. Contrived; added to report.md's residuals.
